story.headline: DeepMind Publishes AlphaProof Nexus Math Agent

story.headline: FBI Arrests OpenAI Engineer Over Hidden Recording Device
story.summary: The FBI and OpenAI publicly disclosed the arrest of OpenAI engineering lead Abdurahman Alfozan over allegations he secretly recorded conversations in a conference room at OpenAI’s San Francisco offices. story.headline: Report: Nvidia CEO Targeted By Alleged Chinese Spy
story.summary: The New York Times reported that U.S. officials found Alice Huang, an executive at Singapore-based data center firm Megaspeed, was allegedly passing intelligence to Beijing while maintaining close ties with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. The report could sharpen scrutiny of Nvidia’s China-related chip sales and the loophole that lets firms in Southeast Asia rent Nvidia-powered computing to Chinese AI labs.

story.headline: Google Won't Give Schools Search Without AI
story.summary: Google said K-12 student accounts will start with Search, Gemini, and Gemini Notebook all off early next year, potentially forcing districts that want AI out of classrooms to also give up Google Search. The move comes amid growing pushback from school districts and lawmakers over AI in education.
